evolution.program.nextActionCompleted: The program is complete. Inspect the final delivery and independent review; archived completion alone does not establish reusable verified learning.
evolution.program.nextActionCancelled: Exploration ended. Evidence remains readable; any unsettled consumption remains visible until reconciliation finishes.
evolution.program.nextActionActive: Work continues after closing the page. Pause advancement to prevent the next experiment from starting.
evolution.program.durabilityNote: The server preserves the goal, frontier, experiment receipts, original sources and recall trace. Browser drafts are separate. Archive recall is evidence, not verified memory; recovery reconciles uncertain outcomes rather than blindly replaying actions.
evolution.program.readFailed: Some records are unavailable. The last confirmed data is preserved.
evolution.program.pauseNote: The current experiment can finish; no next experiment starts while paused.
evolution.program.cancelNote: End the program and interrupt its current execution. Completed experiment records are retained.
evolution.program.retryNote: This starts a new execution. The previous failure and partial results are carried forward.
evolution.program.preparing: The experiment plan is saved and waiting for execution.
evolution.program.runUnavailable: Execution information is temporarily unavailable. This does not establish whether execution has started or stopped. Retry reading or inspect its execution record.
evolution.program.runRetained: The last confirmed execution information is shown. Current information is temporarily unavailable; retry reading to confirm changes.
evolution.program.originalNote: The program completes only after its final original-objective audit passes.
evolution.program.historyNote: View previous experiment results and reviews.
evolution.program.historyEmpty: Records appear here after an experiment settles and is reviewed.
evolution.program.resultEmpty: This experiment did not leave a deliverable result.
evolution.program.reviewEmpty: Acceptance evidence is not available; this cannot prove the objective is complete.

evolution.program.sourceUnavailable: Saved original reading is unavailable here. Open the execution record to inspect its sources.
evolution.program.deliveryRetained: Unable to read the final delivery. The last confirmed content remains visible; refresh to retry.
evolution.program.deliveryUnavailable: No matching final delivery could be read. Refresh to retry or open the final execution record to inspect its evidence.
evolution.program.extendHint: New experiments go before the final review.
evolution.program.usageNote: Usage comes from settled experiments. Current execution may still be consuming resources.
evolution.program.attentionNote: Inspect the experiment result and execution record before retrying or ending the program.

evolution.program.usageIncomplete: Some resource usage could not be confirmed. Counts show observed lower bounds; they exclude unconfirmed usage and are not complete cost measurements.

evolution.studio.missionStageLossRecover: Recovery conditions were not met. Work and evidence remain saved. Inspect interruption details; the executor has not been replayed.
evolution.program.memoryLookupsNote: Relevance does not prove a conclusion; check the original experiment and review.
evolution.program.memoryUnavailable: Archive lookup records are temporarily unavailable. Other progress remains readable.
evolution.program.memoryEmpty: No semantic lookups have been recorded yet. The complete experiment archive remains available above.
evolution.program.memoryCostNote: Original lookup usage is included in the experiment total. Viewing this record incurs no model costs.
evolution.program.memoryNoMatches: No relevant source was selected in this window. This does not establish that the entire archive has no relevant evidence.
evolution.studio.sourceVerdictNote: Delivery status describes the model output. Whether the goal is met is decided by the independent review.
evolution.studio.sourceRecoveryRefused: The saved outcome is incomplete or could not be verified. Known consumption remains recorded; inspect the original and execution record before continuing.

evolution.studio.sourceCompleted: Delivery finished; acceptance depends on independent review.
evolution.studio.sourceReadFailed: This page could not be verified or read. Any page already shown is retained; retry or inspect the execution record.

evolution.studio.sourceLowerBound: Observed lower bounds; total consumption is incomplete.
